scope_statement: These rules and goldens bind deterministic estimator-checker behavior. D0 has no model observations and cannot estimate a PCFL effect. A future exact backend must receive new authority and rerun the bound estimators on the frozen locked cells.

numeric_contract.input_domain: Every item value is an exact decimal or integer in [0,1] and is parsed as a reduced rational. JSON binary64 is not an authority representation.
numeric_contract.difference_domain: Every paired arm difference is a reduced rational in [-1,1].
numeric_contract.arithmetic: Means, variances, grid values, p-value counts, comparisons, and adjusted-p multipliers use reduced integers/rationals. Square roots are never needed for a decision comparison.
numeric_contract.reporting: Report each decision quantity as reduced numerator/denominator plus a decimal rounded half-even to 10 places. Infinity is serialized only as the enum POSITIVE_INFINITY or NEGATIVE_INFINITY, never as a non-JSON number.
numeric_contract.comparison_rule: All thresholds are exact rationals. Do not compare rounded display decimals.

item_score.A3: Minimal success is 1; every failure, defer, malformed output, illegal action, cap exhaustion, censored non-success, or structurally missing dispatched cell is 0.
item_score.A2: Minimal success is 1. A successful item loses exactly min(1/10, avoidable_action_penalty_from_the_ratified_score_table); every non-success/failure/missing disposition is 0.
item_score.separate_reporting: Success and censored regret are separate fields. Regret never changes a failure from zero and is not substituted for the registered item value.

order: For each arm, twin world, ladder, and adapter seed, average the eight locked target values with denominator 8.

Within the same twin world and ladder, average the two paired adapter-seed target means with denominator 2. Non-adapter arms use two deterministic identical seed slots declared by the future manifest; they do not gain replication.
Within the twin world, average the A2 and A3 ladder means with equal weights 1/2 and 1/2.
Within the counterfactual pair, average H and H_dagger world means with equal weights 1/2 and 1/2 to obtain the sole independent score Y[p,arm].
pair_score_aggregation.formula: Y[p,a] = (1/2) * sum_twin[(1/2) * sum_ladder[(1/2) * sum_seed[(1/8) * sum_target value[p,a,twin,ladder,seed,target]]]]
prohibited: target-, episode-, query-, view-, example-, model-call-, or adapter-seed-level pseudo-replication
post-outcome target, seed, twin, world, pair, or reserve replacement
averaging twins before applying item failure-as-zero

locked_usefulness_prerequisite.multiplicity_rationale: U1 is an intersection-union prerequisite for the single bounded positive conclusion and is never reported as a free-standing discovery. All three co-primary rejections and U1 must pass; this extra necessary component cannot increase the type-I error of that conjunction.

confirmation_contrasts.overall_positive_rule: All three Romano-Wolf adjusted co-primary p-values must be <=1/20, both superiority means must be >=1/10, all registered lower-bound gates must pass strictly, U1 must pass all of its strict usefulness gates, every nonstatistical confirmation/binding/visibility/resource gate must pass, and claim_policy.json must permit the exact comparator-qualified conclusion. Otherwise no positive confirmation claim is attempted or retained.

studentizer.centered_values: For null h and pair differences d_i, x_i=d_i-h.
studentizer.sample_variance: s_squared = sum_i((x_i-x_bar)^2)/15; the finite-sample denominator is n-1, never n.
studentizer.statistic: T=x_bar/(s/sqrt(16)). For exact ordering, when variance is positive represent sign(T) and T_squared = (sum_i x_i)^2 * 15 / (16*sum_i(x_i^2) - (sum_i x_i)^2).
zero_variance: If s_squared=0 and x_bar=0, T=ZERO with squared numerator 0 and denominator 1.
studentizer.ordering: NEGATIVE_INFINITY < negative finite values < ZERO < positive finite values < POSITIVE_INFINITY. Compare finite statistics exactly by sign and cross-multiplied squared rational magnitude; reverse magnitude ordering for two negative values.
studentizer.all_zero_rule: An all-zero centered vector has T=ZERO, never NaN. Its observed one-sided sign-flip p-value is 1.

exhaustive_sign_flip.mask_order: Enumerate unsigned masks 0 through 65535 inclusive in increasing integer order.
exhaustive_sign_flip.sign_rule: For pair index i in 0..15, bit i=0 means +1 and bit i=1 means -1. Mask 0 is the observed all-plus vector.
exhaustive_sign_flip.joint_rule: Use the same 16-bit sign vector for every contrast in a max-T family, preserving pair-level dependence.
exhaustive_sign_flip.p_value: p = count(permuted statistic >= observed statistic)/65536. Equality is included. Because enumeration is exhaustive, no add-one correction is applied.

romano_wolf_max_t_stepdown.null_centering: Center each pair vector at its registered null before observed and permuted studentization.
romano_wolf_max_t_stepdown.observed_order: Sort by decreasing observed T. Break an exact T tie by increasing UTF-8 hypothesis_id bytes.
romano_wolf_max_t_stepdown.step: At ordered step k, for each mask take the maximum permuted T over hypotheses not removed before k. The step raw adjusted p is the inclusive exceedance fraction against the step-k observed T.
romano_wolf_max_t_stepdown.monotonicity: The reported adjusted p at step k is max of all step raw adjusted p-values from steps 1..k, capped at 1.
romano_wolf_max_t_stepdown.decision: Reject while reported adjusted p <=1/20. Once a step fails, that and every later ordered hypothesis are not rejected, even if a later unadjusted p is small.
romano_wolf_max_t_stepdown.tie_rule: The hypothesis-id tie order is normative. Inclusive statistic ties and p-value equality at alpha both favor inclusion/rejection exactly as stated.

grid_inverted_lower_bounds.purpose: Deterministic one-sided max-T simultaneous checker bounds for the three co-primary contrasts.
candidate_test: To bound coordinate j at candidate delta, set x_j=d_j-delta.
For every other co-primary coordinate k, set nuisance residuals x_k=d_k-mean(d_k), so its observed statistic is exactly ZERO under the zero-variance convention when appropriate.
For each common sign mask, compute max-T over all three candidate/residual vectors.
The candidate p-value is the fraction of max-T values >= the observed statistic of x_j. Reject the candidate when p<=1/20.
grid_inverted_lower_bounds.endpoint_and_hole_rule: Starting at tick -10000, take the longest contiguous prefix of rejected candidates. The lower bound is its greatest tick. If the first tick is not rejected, report BELOW_DOMAIN and the gate fails. Stop at the first nonrejected tick even if a later tick would reject. If every tick rejects, report AT_UPPER_DOMAIN with bound 1.
grid_inverted_lower_bounds.strict_gate_rule: Compare the unrounded bound tick strictly to the registered gate. Equality fails.
grid_inverted_lower_bounds.u1_rule: Use the same grid and candidate test with a one-coordinate max rather than the three-coordinate family for U1.
grid_inverted_lower_bounds.interpretation: These are frozen finite-sample checker conventions. D0 golden agreement is not evidence that a future model effect exists or that sign symmetry holds for future data.

families.membership: Exactly the future contrasts enumerated under this ID in the separately ratified scientific authorization; D0 contains only synthetic fixtures and cannot add a member.
All and only preregistered A2- and A3-specific superiority contrasts; kept separate from SECONDARY_MECHANISM.

holm_secondary_families.sort: Increasing exact raw p; ties by increasing UTF-8 contrast_id bytes.
holm_secondary_families.step_threshold: At one-indexed rank r of m, reject if p_r <= (1/20)/(m-r+1). Stop after the first failure.
holm_secondary_families.adjusted_p: adj_p_r=max_{q<=r}((m-q+1)*p_q), capped at 1, then mapped back to contrast_id.
holm_secondary_families.raw_p_source: The exact one-sided exhaustive paired sign-flip rule at the preregistered null unless a future ratification explicitly binds another valid raw test before outcomes exist.
holm_secondary_families.ties: Lexical ordering is normative; equality to the Holm threshold rejects.

bootstrap_robustness_only.joint_resampling: Use one index vector for every arm and contrast in a replicate. Draw pair indices with replacement; never resample targets, seeds, twins, or ladders independently.
bootstrap_robustness_only.rng_root: Use split_seed_manifest.json derive(namespace,labels,counter) exactly as written with namespace='statistics', labels=['confirmation-bootstrap'], and counter=0. Under protocol PCFL-D0-EXACT-V2 this produces stream-key hex f9468652e410b813a8c4cd142ecf4ff99c3186c73ba01ef16439589df11fc99f. The statistics namespace remains dormant/non-openable in D0; D0 may test only the fixed golden primitive inputs.
bootstrap_robustness_only.rng_derivation: For replicate r as uint64 big-endian, draw j as uint32 big-endian, and rejection counter q as uint32 big-endian, digest = SHA256(root || 0x00 || UTF8('bootstrap') || 0x00 || r || 0x00 || j || 0x00 || q). Interpret digest[0:8] as unsigned uint64 big-endian x. Let limit=floor(2^64/16)*16. If x>=limit increment q; otherwise index=x mod 16.
bootstrap_robustness_only.interval: For a two-sided 95% descriptive percentile interval, sort the 100000 exact replicate means. The lower value is zero-based element 2499 and the upper value is element 97499 (inverse empirical CDF with inclusive nearest rank).
bootstrap_robustness_only.decision_use: Report-only robustness. Bootstrap output cannot create, rescue, stop, expand, mask, or overturn any registered decision.

calibration_power_screen.when: After all six locked calibration pair scores are frozen and before any confirmation outcome is dispatched or unmasked.
calibration_power_screen.calibration_sd: For each vector use sample variance denominator 5. Failures are zeros and remain in n=6.

critical_constant.name: z_0.9875
critical_constant.reason: Fixed one-sided Bonferroni planning constant for four necessary gates at total 0.05. It is a conservative planning screen, not the confirmation test.

calibration_power_screen.exact_projected_lower_comparison: For threshold b, require mean-b>0 and 16*(mean-b)^2 > z_0.9875^2*s_cal^2. This is exactly equivalent to mean-z*s_cal/4>b without computing a square root.
adequate_at_16: D1 calibration mean >=1/10 and its projected lower value >0.
D2 calibration mean >=1/10 and its projected lower value >0.
U1 calibration mean >0 and its projected lower value >0.
calibration_power_screen.zero_variance: If s_cal^2=0, a gate passes the projected-lower comparison exactly when its mean is strictly above b; D1/D2 still must meet the inclusive 1/10 mean gate.
calibration_power_screen.decision: If every condition is true, confirmation may be requested only through a new exact authorization. If any condition is false, status is INADEQUATE_POWER_AT_16_NO_POSITIVE_CLAIM: do not attempt a positive confirmation claim, do not unmask or dispatch confirmation for claim-seeking, do not use reserves, and do not increase n. A larger study requires new deliberation and human ratification.
calibration_power_screen.masked_partial_confirmation: The first 12 of 16 confirmation pairs may be run operationally but remain masked. They cannot enter this power screen, stop the study, change n, add a contrast, replace a pair, or authorize a claim.

after_scientific_dispatch: Failure, defer, malformed output, illegal action, action/operation cap, backend error, indeterminate model call, missing response, missing adapter cell, and unrecoverable dispatched cell all contribute item value 0 at every fixed aggregation slot.
A missing record is materialized as an explicit zero-valued record with reason, expected cell identity, and no replacement. It is never silently imputed.
All-zero arms/vectors remain valid inputs with zero statistic and p=1; they are not dropped as degenerate.
before_any_scientific_dispatch: Structural generator exhaustion, impossible S-bind derangement after the one allowed predeclared adjacent-bin merge, split/hash collision, schema failure, or whole-platform infrastructure loss blocks science and yields no estimator result.
A whole-platform interruption may resume only the identical hash-bound cell before any scientific dispatch. It never selects a new world, seed, order, pair, or reserve.
missing_failure_and_replacement.reserve_rule: An ordered reserve may be consumed only for generator structural exhaustion or pre-science infrastructure loss under a future explicit authority, never because of an outcome, controller value, model failure, difficulty, variance, or power.
missing_failure_and_replacement.confirmation_n: Exactly 16 fixed pairs or no confirmation decision. No 12-pair decision and no complete-case n are legal.

requirements: Aggregation order and a missing-as-zero case
all-zero, positive-zero-variance, negative-zero-variance, and balanced-zero-mean studentizers
grid lower-bound endpoint and strict-threshold behavior
adequate and inadequate calibration power-screen arrays
golden_binding.mismatch_disposition: Any mismatch is D0 checker nonconformance. It cannot be waived by approximate agreement or used as scientific evidence.
